description: SET [SIZE OF] data-name TO n (ISO §2023:14.9.39 Format 16) — a COBOL-2023 addition: set the current length of a DYNAMIC LENGTH elementary item (growing space-fills the added positions, GR39; shrinking drops trailing positions). Semantic gate on the BoundSetSize node (the target must be dynamic-length), covering both the explicit SIZE OF form and the bare re-routed form. The DYNAMIC LENGTH clause itself is 2014, but the SET-length form is 2023.
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.39 Format 16 (§2023:14.9.39.4 GR37-39); Annex E.3.3 item — the dynamic-length SET
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. SETSZ.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 D PIC X DYNAMIC LENGTH.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    MOVE "HI" TO D.
    SET SIZE OF D TO 4.
    STOP RUN.
